mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO workflow_invocation (tenant_id, run_id, invocation_id, idempotency_key, node_execution_id, invocation_type, replay_class, status, downstream_request_id, trace_id, started_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{runId}, #{invocationId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{nodeExecutionId}, #{invocationType}, #{replayClass}, #{status}, #{downstreamRequestId}, #{traceId}, #{startedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_invocation SET status = #{status}, downstream_request_id = COALESCE(#{downstreamRequestId}, downstream_request_id), finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND invocation_id = #{invocationId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND deleted = 0
